[Positron](https://positron.posit.co) is a next-generation data science IDE from
[Posit](https://posit.co) that combines ideas from RStudio and Visual Studio
Code. [Posit Assistant](https://positron.posit.co/assistant.html) is the AI
assistant built into Positron.

## Getting set up

* Setup guide: <https://posit-dev.github.io/positron-workshop/setup.html>
* Latest release: <https://positron.posit.co/download.html>
* Pre-releases: <https://github.com/posit-dev/positron/releases>
